summary.intent: Run Session 2 of the v1-alpha launch plan: implement WP D (init boundary: branch-name handling and workflow-only retry), then continue with WPs J and L. Lead follow-ups added fixes for review findings on PR #565.
summary.outcome: WP D was implemented, reviewed, mutation-tested and pushed as PR #565 on trail #357. Follow-up fixes (untrack mutants.out.old, single-pass placeholder substitution, E304 for non-Cargo artifact owners) were pushed and both Entire findings resolved. WP J (twine OIDC env vars) is implemented and its commit was just issued; WP L has not been started.

repo: Branch names were previously derived by taking the last '/' segment of a ref, which truncated names like release/next. A BranchName type in callisto-model identity.rs now strips the full refs/heads or refs/remotes prefix.

Workflow templates are filled via placeholder replacement (__BRANCH__, __COMMIT__, __VERSION__). Sequential replace rescans inserted values, so it was changed to a single pass. WorkflowScalar JSON-quotes values and escapes + and ! in the trigger filter.
callisto-model has its own Version type, so callisto-cli does not need a semver dependency.

CLI init tests live in crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/init/tests.rs and graph init tests in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init/tests.rs. Insta snapshots there needed updating for the quoted branch output.

Repo gate is `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check` and `just test` (nextest); an architecture test forbids granting apply permits from a literal. Docs specs (docs/specs/cli.json) must be updated alongside CLI behavior changes.
The workflow-only retry path (`init --workflow`) must reuse the user's existing callisto.toml for detection, refuse answer flags it would silently drop, and report a real write rather than a dry run.
commands/matrix.rs drops artifacts whose owner the generated builder doesn't support (non-Cargo), so init must reject them up front (E304) rather than ship a workflow that fails at release.
Signed commits are required; /usr/bin/git is used directly, pushes use an explicit refspec and are verified with git ls-remote. mutants.out*/ is gitignored.

code.finding: render_init prints '[DRY-RUN] Would write ... (no files written)' whenever InitReport.initialized is false, which mislabeled real workflow-only writes.
detect_initialized/detect_facts re-ran tag-template detection against a freshly rendered config instead of the user's file, causing spurious E193/E194 on retry.
Drops artifacts with unsupported owners (e.g. npm), producing the 'callisto matrix has no entry for artifact slot' release failure.

workflow: Subagent reviewer found real defects from source alone; its hand-back is model output, so findings were verified against the code before fixing.
Mutation testing (cargo mutants --in-diff) exposed missed mutants such as `||`→`&&` in flag checks, driving additional tests. A `+`→`-` mutant in fill timed out because it loops forever.
Hold edits while a background mutation run uses the same worktree, since --in-place mutates the files.
Run gate commands by exit code, and delete a worktree's target/ after finishing to free disk.
Use EnterWorktree with name= rather than path= to avoid the relocation prompt, and limit builds with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS and debug=0 profiles.

friction: BSD sed on macOS failed on escaped-quote substitutions, forcing fallback to Python edit scripts or the Edit tool.
Some research JSONs were untracked in the main checkout, so F09 had to be found via /tmp audit report and the main tree.
A worktree-entry prompt stopped the session, and the lead had to resume it in the D worktree.

Initial changeset wording overstated the escaping limit (said 'leading' + or !), and the first version of the retry path had a dry-run mislabel, ignored the existing config and dropped flags silently.
Several repeated duplicate Bash calls and a first mutation run were needed before the review findings could be edited, since edits were blocked while mutants ran.
The final J commit needed repeated attempts after fmt-check failed.
open_items: WP L has not been started.
WP J commit was just issued and its signature and gate results were not confirmed in the transcript; it still needs pushing and trail linking to #459.
